description: Add rows to the end of the visual's data and drop the oldest past keepLast; the visual's settings are unchanged. Adds rows to a line, area, bar, bar-horizontal, scatter, table or map visual; its settings (xKey, series, columns) are unchanged, and numeric strings are coerced as on push. On a map the rows merge by region: a row whose code matches an existing one replaces it, the others are added, and keepLast is ignored. A kpi, gauge, pie, funnel or markdown visual has no row list: replace its document with PUT /v1/visuals/{id}/data instead. Over HTTP keepLast may also go in the query string (?keepLast=7), and the body may be text/csv: the header row is the keys the visual's rows have. Needs an API key: with none yet, call signup first.

keepLast.description: Keep only the newest keepLast rows after the append, dropping the oldest. The type's cap applies in any case: line 500, area 500, bar 500, bar-horizontal 500, scatter 500, table 200, map 4000 rows.

rows.description: Added after the rows the visual holds, in order.

items.description: One data row, with the keys the visual's rows have: the xKey and the series keys, or the column keys.

name: append_rows
